findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
1) Inspector observed a buildup of soils on the ice machine baffles. Educated PIC on proper baffle maintenance. Ensure baffles are kept clean to prevent food contamination.

2) Inspector observed ice scoops being stored on top of ice machine. Educated PIC on proper ice scoop storage. Ensure ice scoops are kept in a clean and sanitary place, as they are a food contact surface.

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed soda syrup to be stored on a shelf made of bare wood. Educated PIC on the use nonabsorbent and easily cleanable materials for areas that can get wet. Ensure the shelves are replaced, or coated with a nonabsorbent paint or sealant.

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Inspector observed no test strips for chlorine or quat in the facility. Educated PIC on proper utilization of test strips. Ensure the facility has test strips to indicate the concentration of sanitizer used when cleaning.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed fans to be dirty in the walk-in cooler. Educated PIC on proper cleaning of fans in cooler. Ensure fans are cleaned regularly to maintain clean surfaces.

4-601.11: (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container 

Observed ice scoop with handle in contact with ice in the ice bin. Discussed with PIC. PIC removed scoop from the ice bin.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P).

Observed a beer bottle stored in the ice bin behind bar. Discussed with PIC, do not store anything in the ice, especially glass as it is a contamination risk to the ice itself and poses a safety hazard if glass breaks/chips. COS- PIC removed beer from ice.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

Observed a drink dispenser, and various dirty utensils in the handsink behind bar. Spoke to PIC, ensure handsink is accessible at all times. PIC removed utensils and dispenser from the sink.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

Upon arrival, ice scoop observed w/ handle in ice. PIC removed ice scoop and placed on top of ice bin.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

Wet wiping cloths observed in handsink basin upon arrival. Ensure sinks are accessible at all times. PIC removed cloths and placed in a sani bucket.
